item.title: Create a Composed App
item.description: This section describes how to create a composed app in a federated project. You can customize the services, workloads, and routes of an application to create a composed app. Compared to template-based applications, composed apps support application governance. You can enable application governance for composed apps to use traffic monitoring, canary release, and tracing features. Prerequisites The Federated Cluster App Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.

item.title: View Composed App List
item.description: This section describes how to view the app list in a federated project. Prerequisites The Federated Cluster App Management extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project View permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project View permissions and enter your federated project.
